name: TM7 Ultimate Beef & Pork Lasagne
ingredients: 120 g carrots, peeled and cut into chunks
Leaves from 1 small rosemary sprig (approx. 3 g)
1 tsp salt (approx. 6 g), plus extra to taste
1/2 tsp black pepper (approx. 1 g), plus extra to taste
225 g mozzarella, drained and torn or diced

steps.text: Add 120 g celery, 120 g carrots, 100 g onion and 10 g garlic cloves to the mixing bowl. Chop 5 sec / speed 5. Scrape down the sides of the bowl. Add 30 g olive oil and 3 g rosemary leaves. Cook 8 min / 120°C / speed 1 with the measuring cup removed.

Add 420 g beef mince, 200 g pork mince, 6 g salt and 1 g black pepper, breaking the mince into chunks around the blade. Cook 10 min / 120°C / reverse / speed 1 with the measuring cup removed and the simmering basket on the lid. After about 5 minutes, pause and use the spatula to break up any larger pieces if needed.
Add 250 g red wine. Cook 15 min / 120°C / reverse / speed 1 with the measuring cup removed and the simmering basket on the lid, allowing the wine to reduce.

Add 500 g chopped tomatoes and 120 g beef stock. Cook 50 min / 98°C / reverse / speed 1 with the measuring cup removed and the simmering basket on the lid. The ragù should be rich and fairly thick rather than watery.

Check the ragù. If it still looks too loose, cook 10 min / 120°C / reverse / speed 1 with the measuring cup removed and the simmering basket on the lid. Taste and adjust salt and pepper. Transfer the ragù to a large bowl and set aside.
Rinse the mixing bowl. Add 600 g whole milk, 20 g onion, 1 bay leaf and a good pinch of freshly grated nutmeg. Cook 8 min / 90°C / reverse / speed 1.

Remove and discard the bay leaf. Add 40 g butter, 40 g plain flour, 3 g salt and black pepper to taste. Cook 7 min / 90°C / speed 4, then mix 10 sec / speed 5. The béchamel should be smooth, creamy and loose enough to spread.
Preheat the oven to 180°C conventional / 160°C fan. Use 8-10 fresh lasagne sheets. If using dried sheets instead, soak them in boiling water for about 5 minutes, then drain.

Spread a thin layer of béchamel over the base of a deep baking dish (about 25 x 20 cm). Build three layers using the ragù, lasagne sheets, 225 g mozzarella, 40 g Parmesan, black pepper and béchamel. Finish with lasagne sheets, the remaining béchamel, mozzarella and Parmesan. Dot 15 g butter over the top.
Place the dish on a baking tray and bake uncovered in the preheated oven for 30-35 minutes, until deeply golden, bubbling around the edges and the pasta is tender.
Leave the lasagne to rest for 10-15 minutes before cutting and serving. This helps the layers set and gives cleaner slices.
